items.criterion: The health route answers 200 once the database and the object store are reachable.
items.judgment: Call the health route from outside the container and read the status.

items.criterion: Both seeded accounts sign in with the corpus password and receive a token carrying their role.
items.judgment: Post each seeded email with the pinned password and read the returned role.

items.criterion: The public catalogue endpoint returns the six published projects and omits both seeded drafts.
items.judgment: Read the catalogue endpoint anonymously and compare the slug set with the seed.

items.criterion: The draft thumbnail route refuses an anonymous caller.
items.judgment: Request the draft thumbnail route with no token and read the status.

items.criterion: The draft thumbnail route refuses a signed-in visitor.
items.judgment: Request the draft thumbnail route with a visitor token and read the status.

items.criterion: The draft thumbnail route serves the stored bytes to a signed-in curator.
items.judgment: Request the draft thumbnail route with a curator token and read the body length.

items.criterion: An uploaded thumbnail becomes a real object in the bucket under the pinned key scheme.
items.judgment: Upload an image as a curator and list the bucket for the key the project reports.

items.criterion: A project created through the wizard starts in the draft state and stays out of the public catalogue.
items.judgment: Create a project as a curator, then read the catalogue anonymously.

items.criterion: Publishing a project adds it to the public catalogue and raises the published count by one.
items.judgment: Read the count, publish, read the count again.

items.criterion: A project create issued from a visitor session is refused at the API.
items.judgment: Post a project with a visitor token and read the status.

items.criterion: A stored enquiry returns a reference in the ENQ form and the same reference appears in the curator inbox.
items.judgment: Post an enquiry, then read the inbox with a curator token.

items.criterion: The wildcard application stores its uploaded file in the bucket under the applications key scheme.
items.judgment: Submit a wildcard application and list the bucket for the reported key.

items.criterion: The project wall reads as a dark, near-monochrome surface with one warm accent reserved for highlight.
items.judgment: Look at the home route and decide whether a second hue family appears outside the accent role.

items.criterion: The enquiry flow moves through intent, form and confirmation on three separate addresses.
items.judgment: Walk the enquiry flow and watch the address change at each step.

items.criterion: Cards on the project wall overshoot a touch and settle as they enter.
items.judgment: Load the home route and watch the card entrance.
